bounded_graphical_section_measurement.calibration_description: Bottom dimension line of SECTION LOOKING WEST; two outer building extent witnesses. Calibrates sheet graphical scale only, not a cantilever or room dimension.
bounded_graphical_section_measurement.method: Apply width1024 graphical calibration to vertical sheet distances, assuming isotropic architectural drawing. Delta-output-y * (142/1700) * (20.4724/389.7). No photo pixel ratios and no model-derived endpoint selection.
bounded_graphical_section_measurement.uncertainty_description: Manual 3px output line choice at each target, calibration-witness choice, line thickness and finish-line identification allowance. Conservative reading bound, not statistical confidence interval; source not a local soffit elevation survey.
